status: Read-only visual measurement; no image or framing edits
method: Body silhouette width measured at three middle-body scanlines, 12 RGB-level contrast threshold, then multiplied by current CSS scale. Clear glass highlights and frosted edges limit precision. Height uses existing source baseline and detected mouth edge.
finding: Cap-only clear and frosted heights match at approximately 1484 image pixels; frosted body is about 3.2 percent wider. Cap-only clear is about 2.7 percent narrower than clear spray; frosted cap-only is about 2 percent wider than frosted spray. These are residual image geometry differences, not different physical bottle dimensions.
